run_spark_sql: run a Spark SQL file with configurable CLI args, configs, and optional NUMA node binding
write_sql_create_tables: generate SQL statements to create Parquet tables from JSON dataset release metadata
parse_per_stage_runtime: parse a Spark execution log file to extract per-stage start and end timestamps
run_benchmark_tests: run benchmark test queries with cache dropping, timing, and per-stage runtime analysis
start_spark_cluster: start a Spark standalone cluster with master, workers, and shuffle service with NUMA policies
